8226:4244.name: *Button/Fill
8226:4244.description:
Status: 🔵 Ready for Review

Atomic tier: Atom.

Primary filled button for the highest-emphasis action (Confirm, Save, CTA).

Props:
- label / labelSuccess / labelDanger: text overrides per variant.
- icon / iconLoading: instance swaps.
- State: Default | Hover | Active | Disabled | Loading | Focus.
- iconPlacement: none | left | right.
- variant: default | success | danger | label.

Note: no Size prop, single size only. Align with code before adding sizes.
